property_summary: After calling DrugDealer() from address A, then collectDrugs(B) from A (where B is also the referral), the reference contract sets Kilos[A] and claimedDrugs[B] using the old claimedDrugs[A] before clearing it, while the mutant sets claimedDrugs[B] after Kilos[A] uses the cleared claimedDrugs[A], causing claimedDrugs[B] to differ; here we use hard-coded values and warp to trigger a specific nonzero drugsUsed=86400 so newKilo=1, and the claimedDrugs[B] difference is observable via c.claimedDrugs(B).
change_summary: Swap the order of the two assignment statements (one for Kilos, one for claimedDrugs of ref) by moving the claimedDrugs update before the Kilos update.
